editDialog.title: Edit Memory
editDialog.description: Supports markdown; content will be fed back to the CLI, keep it concise.

reviewDialog.title: Distill Memories
reviewDialog.description: Distill reusable facts/preferences/decisions/conventions from this session; existing ones are auto-marked as duplicates. Check items to save into the memory ledger (with source).
reviewDialog.errorNoAi: AI service not configured (set an API Key in Settings, or switch to a local CLI provider)

filesBar.unsyncedDesc: Write 'global + this project' memories into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md (managed block, fed back to CLI)
filesBar.toastEmpty: No memories to inject; managed block cleared

page.title: Memory Ledger
page.description: Reusable memories distilled and deduplicated from claude / codex sessions; fed back to any CLI (external tools query via MCP search_memory).
page.importButtonTitle: Scan ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/*.md and import as pending memories
page.importNone: No file memories found to import
page.pendingDesc: — Written by external AI via MCP; enter ledger after acceptance
page.emptyHint: No memories yet. Click "Distill Memories" in a session preview to capture memories.
